subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the two people in trouble

733540101.text: The color and intensity of the lighting are perfectly calibrated, and the special effects are simply spectacular. It wouldn't be an exaggeration to name this "effect-ion perfection."

733540102.text: Amazing, Safi! It's all thanks to you that we were able to see the Knight of Flowers in all his glory, just like in the legends.

733540103.text: Oh, pish-posh! I can't take all the credit myself, now can I? Just think of all the work you did. It was far more exhausting than the papers I pushed around.

733540104.text: The most important thing now is the candidate we choose to play the Knight of Flowers... The performer must possess extraordinary skill, with an aura that can compare to the legendary Farris himself. Hmm, those requirements do seem to be a bit steep, don't they?

733540107.text: Lighting? Special effects? Are you guys worried about putting on a show?

733540108.text: They have appeared! The one and only, the illustrious hero without equal, the supreme candidate to play the Knight of Flowers...

733540109.text: No, what I should say is that you yourself fully deserve the title "Knight of Flowers." No asterisks attached!

733540110.text: #Yikes, this is one excited scholar! His eyes lit up the second he saw you, {NICKNAME}...
